description.text: Ten single attacks (0.69 each), grants [High Quick Cast 2], [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Holy)], [Enhanced Mastery Mode] and [Enhanced Mastery Boost 1] to the user

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Fire/Ice/Holy ability

description.name: Enhanced Mastery Mode
description.text: Grants [Enhanced Mastery Boost 2]/[Enhanced Mastery Boost 3] after using 1/2+ Fire, Ice or Holy abilities, casts Straightarrow after using a Fire, Ice or Holy ability

description.name: Enhanced Mastery Boost 1
description.text: ATK +20%, removed if the character hasn't [Enhanced Mastery Mode]
